#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reconstruct per-year MC PDFs from structured DB content.

One page per question. Uses content_block + option assets when present;
otherwise embeds the provenance PNG.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pymupdf as fitz

SCRIPTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(SCRIPTS))

from mc_db import ROOT, YEAR_ORDER, connect  # noqa: E402

PAGE_W = 595.0
MARGIN = 32.0


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("--db", type=Path, default=ROOT / "paper2db.sqlite")
    p.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=ROOT / "reconstructed")
    p.add_argument("--years", nargs="*", default=None)
    p.add_argument(
        "--only-structured",
        action="store_true",
        help="Only include questions with cropped stem/option assets",
    )
    return p.parse_args()


def resolve_path(rel: str | None) -> Path | None:
    if not rel:
        return None
    path = Path(rel)
    if not path.is_absolute():
        path = ROOT / path
    return path if path.is_file() else None


def latexish_to_text(s: str) -> str:
    if not s:
        return ""
    text = s
    for pat, rep in [
        (r"\$([^$]+)\$", r"\1"),
        (r"\\mathrm\{([^}]+)\}", r"\1"),
        (r"\\text\{([^}]+)\}", r"\1"),
        (r"\\circ", "°"),
        (r"\\theta", "θ"),
        (r"\\alpha", "α"),
        (r"\\beta", "β"),
        (r"\\pi", "π"),
        (r"\\times", "×"),
        (r"\\cdot", "·"),
        (r"\\frac\{([^{}]+)\}\{([^{}]+)\}", r"(\1)/(\2)"),
        (r"\\", ""),
        (r"[{}]", ""),
    ]:
        text = re.sub(pat, rep, text)
    return re.sub(r"[ \t]+\n", "\n", text).strip()


def paper_ids(conn, years: list[str] | None) -> list[str]:
    found = [r[0] for r in conn.execute("SELECT id FROM paper ORDER BY id")]
    ordered = [y for y in YEAR_ORDER if y in found]
    ordered.extend(y for y in found if y not in ordered)
    if years:
        allowed = set(years)
        ordered = [y for y in ordered if y in allowed]
    return ordered


def has_structured_images(conn, question_id: str) -> bool:
    n = conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM asset_role
        WHERE question_id = ? AND role IN ('stem_figure', 'option_figure')
        """,
        (question_id,),
    ).fetchone()[0]
    return n > 0


def draw_text(page: fitz.Page, x: float, y: float, text: str, fontsize: float = 10) -> float:
    text = latexish_to_text(text)
    if not text:
        return y
    width = PAGE_W - MARGIN - x
    # Approximate wrap
    words = text.replace("\n", " \n ").split()
    lines: list[str] = []
    cur = ""
    for word in words:
        if word == "\n":
            lines.append(cur)
            cur = ""
            continue
        trial = (cur + " " + word).strip()
        if fitz.get_text_length(trial, fontname="helv", fontsize=fontsize) <= width:
            cur = trial
        else:
            if cur:
                lines.append(cur)
            cur = word
    if cur:
        lines.append(cur)
    for line in lines:
        page.insert_text((x, y + fontsize), line, fontsize=fontsize, fontname="helv")
        y += fontsize + 3
    return y + 4


def draw_image(page: fitz.Page, x: float, y: float, path: Path, max_w: float, max_h: float) -> float:
    with fitz.open(path) as img:
        iw, ih = img[0].rect.width, img[0].rect.height
    scale = min(max_w / iw, max_h / ih, 1.0)
    tw, th = iw * scale, ih * scale
    rect = fitz.Rect(x, y, x + tw, y + th)
    page.insert_image(rect, filename=str(path))
    return y + th + 8


def estimate_height(conn, qid: str, structured: bool, provenance: str | None) -> float:
    if not structured:
        path = resolve_path(provenance)
        if path:
            with fitz.open(path) as img:
                return img[0].rect.height
        return 842
    h = MARGIN + 24
    for _pos, btype, text, _label, storage in conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT position, block_type, text_content, figure_label, a.storage_path
        FROM content_block cb LEFT JOIN asset a ON a.id = cb.asset_id
        WHERE question_id = ? ORDER BY position
        """,
        (qid,),
    ):
        if btype in {"text", "equation"} and text:
            h += 14 * (2 + len(text) // 80)
        elif btype == "figure" and resolve_path(storage):
            h += 200
    # options grid roughly
    h += 280
    return max(842.0, min(h + MARGIN, 1600.0))


def render_structured_page(doc: fitz.Document, conn, qrow) -> None:
    qid, number, is_extended, footer, _fmt, provenance = qrow
    structured = has_structured_images(conn, qid)

    if not structured:
        path = resolve_path(provenance)
        if path is None:
            page = doc.new_page(width=PAGE_W, height=200)
            page.insert_text((MARGIN, 60), f"{number}. missing", fontsize=12)
            return
        with fitz.open(path) as img:
            rect = img[0].rect
            page = doc.new_page(width=rect.width, height=rect.height)
            page.insert_image(page.rect, filename=str(path))
        return

    height = estimate_height(conn, qid, True, provenance)
    page = doc.new_page(width=PAGE_W, height=height)
    y = MARGIN
    title = f"{'*' if is_extended else ''}{number}."
    page.insert_text((MARGIN, y + 12), title, fontsize=12, fontname="helv")
    y += 20

    for _pos, btype, text, label, storage in conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT cb.position, cb.block_type, cb.text_content, cb.figure_label, a.storage_path
        FROM content_block cb LEFT JOIN asset a ON a.id = cb.asset_id
        WHERE cb.question_id = ? ORDER BY cb.position
        """,
        (qid,),
    ):
        if btype in {"text", "equation"} and text:
            y = draw_text(page, MARGIN, y, text, fontsize=10)
        elif btype == "figure":
            path = resolve_path(storage)
            if path:
                if label:
                    y = draw_text(page, MARGIN, y, label, fontsize=9)
                y = draw_image(page, MARGIN + 40, y, path, PAGE_W - 2 * MARGIN - 80, 220)

    for num, text, storage in conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT s.number, s.text_content, a.storage_path
        FROM statement s LEFT JOIN asset a ON a.id = s.asset_id
        WHERE s.question_id = ? ORDER BY s.number
        """,
        (qid,),
    ):
        path = resolve_path(storage)
        if path:
            y = draw_text(page, MARGIN, y, f"({num})", fontsize=10)
            y = draw_image(page, MARGIN + 20, y, path, PAGE_W * 0.6, 160)
        else:
            y = draw_text(page, MARGIN, y, f"({num}) {text or ''}", fontsize=10)

    # Options
    container = conn.execute(
        "SELECT layout FROM options_container WHERE question_id = ?",
        (qid,),
    ).fetchone()
    layout = container[0] if container else "vertical"

    opt = {}
    for letter, text, storage in conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT orow.letter, ocell.text_content, a.storage_path
        FROM option_row orow
        LEFT JOIN option_cell ocell ON ocell.option_row_id = orow.id
        LEFT JOIN asset a ON a.id = ocell.asset_id
        WHERE orow.question_id = ?
        ORDER BY orow.letter, ocell.cell_index
        """,
        (qid,),
    ):
        info = opt.setdefault(letter, {"text": "", "path": None})
        if text:
            info["text"] = (info["text"] + " " + text).strip()
        if storage and "option_" in storage:
            info["path"] = storage

    has_images = any(resolve_path(opt.get(L, {}).get("path")) for L in "ABCD")
    if has_images and layout in {"grid_2x2", "table"} or (has_images and layout == "grid_2x2"):
        cell_w = (PAGE_W - 2 * MARGIN - 10) / 2
        # measure
        row_h = 120.0
        for L in "ABCD":
            p = resolve_path(opt.get(L, {}).get("path"))
            if not p:
                continue
            with fitz.open(p) as img:
                iw, ih = img[0].rect.width, img[0].rect.height
            row_h = max(row_h, min(180.0, ih * ((cell_w - 28) / iw)))
        positions = {"A": (0, 0), "B": (1, 0), "C": (0, 1), "D": (1, 1)}
        for letter, (col, row) in positions.items():
            x = MARGIN + col * (cell_w + 10)
            yy = y + row * (row_h + 16)
            page.insert_text((x, yy + 10), f"{letter}.", fontsize=10, fontname="helv")
            p = resolve_path(opt.get(letter, {}).get("path"))
            if p:
                draw_image(page, x + 16, yy, p, cell_w - 20, row_h)
        y += 2 * (row_h + 16)
    else:
        for letter in "ABCD":
            info = opt.get(letter, {})
            p = resolve_path(info.get("path"))
            if p:
                page.insert_text((MARGIN, y + 10), f"{letter}.", fontsize=10, fontname="helv")
                y = draw_image(page, MARGIN + 18, y, p, PAGE_W - 2 * MARGIN - 18, 160)
            else:
                y = draw_text(page, MARGIN, y, f"{letter}. {info.get('text') or ''}", fontsize=10)

    if footer:
        y = draw_text(page, MARGIN, y + 6, footer, fontsize=9)


def main() -> None:
    args = parse_args()
    if not args.db.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f"Database not found: {args.db}")
    conn = connect(args.db)
    try:
        years = paper_ids(conn, args.years)
        totals = {"structured": 0, "provenance": 0, "skipped": 0}
        for paper_id in years:
            doc = fitz.open()
            try:
                rows = conn.execute(
                    """
                    SELECT id, number, is_extended, section_footer, format_tag, provenance_png
                    FROM question WHERE paper_id = ? ORDER BY number
                    """,
                    (paper_id,),
                ).fetchall()
                for qrow in rows:
                    qid = qrow[0]
                    structured = has_structured_images(conn, qid)
                    if args.only_structured and not structured:
                        totals["skipped"] += 1
                        continue
                    render_structured_page(doc, conn, qrow)
                    totals["structured" if structured else "provenance"] += 1
                if doc.page_count == 0:
                    print(f"No pages for {paper_id}")
                    continue
                dest = args.out / paper_id / "combined.pdf"
                dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                doc.save(dest, garbage=4, deflate=True)
                print(f"Wrote {dest} ({doc.page_count} pages)", flush=True)
            finally:
                doc.close()
        print("Modes:", totals)
    finally:
        conn.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def split_stem_text(ocr_text: str, has_stem_figure: bool) -> list[str]:
    """Split OCR stem into text chunks around a figure (heuristic)."""
    text = ocr_text.strip()
    text = re.sub(r"^\s*[#*]?\s*\d{1,2}\s*[.．、)]\s*", "", text)
    # Drop trailing OCR noise that looks like option markers / axis junk
    text = re.split(r"\n\s*[A-D]\s*[.．、)]\s*", text, maxsplit=1)[0]
    text = re.sub(r"(?s)\n[A-D]\s*[.．、)].*$", "", text).strip()
    if not has_stem_figure:
        return [text] if text else []
    parts = re.split(r"\n(?=If |Which |What |Find |Determine )", text, maxsplit=1)
    parts = [p.strip() for p in parts if p.strip()]
    return parts or ([text] if text else [])

def trim_option_label(crop: Image.Image) -> Image.Image:
    """Remove leading A./B./C./D. label from an option crop using left-ink scan."""
    gray = np.asarray(crop.convert("L"))
    h, w = gray.shape

def demote_to_text_options(conn, question_id: str, cache_dir: Path) -> None:
    """Restore OCR text options for mis-tagged questions; drop option_figure assets."""
    from ocr_mc_questions import ocr_png, parse_question
    from mc_db import (
        classify_format,
        combo_statement_sets,
        detect_extended,
        detect_section_footer,
        file_sha256,
        insert_question_structure,
        parse_combo_statements,
        tabular_column_headers,
    )

    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT paper_id, number, provenance_png FROM question WHERE id = ?",
        (question_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if not row:
        print(f"  skip demote missing {question_id}")
        return
    paper_id, number, provenance = row[0], int(row[1]), row[2]
    source = ROOT / provenance
    if not source.is_file():
        print(f"  skip demote missing png {question_id}")
        return

    # Keep answer
    answer_row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT correct_letter, correct_percentage, is_deleted FROM answer WHERE question_id = ?",
        (question_id,),
    ).fetchone()

    ocr_text = ocr_png(source, cache_dir=cache_dir / paper_id)
    stem, options = parse_question(ocr_text)
    format_tag, layout, option_kind = classify_format(ocr_text, options, number=number)
    if format_tag == "image_or_graph_options":
        format_tag, layout, option_kind = "text_options", "vertical", "text"

    statements = None
    combo_sets = None
    if format_tag == "combo_statements":
        statements = parse_combo_statements(ocr_text) or None
        combo_sets = combo_statement_sets(options)

    with Image.open(source) as image:
        width, height = image.size
    insert_question_structure(
        conn,
        question_id=question_id,
        paper_id=paper_id,
        number=number,
        is_extended=detect_extended(ocr_text),
        section_footer=detect_section_footer(ocr_text, number),
        format_tag=format_tag,
        provenance_png=Path(provenance).as_posix() if not Path(provenance).is_absolute() else str(Path(provenance).relative_to(ROOT)),
        stem_text=stem,
        options=options,
        layout=layout,
        option_kind=option_kind,
        column_headers=tabular_column_headers(format_tag, options, ocr_text),
        asset_hash=file_sha256(source),
        image_width=width,
        image_height=height,
        statements=statements,
        combo_sets=combo_sets,
    )
    if answer_row:
        conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO answer (question_id, correct_letter, correct_percentage, is_deleted)

def trim_option_label(crop: Image.Image) -> Image.Image:
    """Remove leading A./B./C./D. from an option crop (left / top-left scan).

    Labels often sit well left of the figure, but some papers place them close
    to the axes (x ~ 130 inside the option cell). Scan far enough to catch both.
    """
    gray = np.asarray(crop.convert("L"))
    h, w = gray.shape
    if w < 40 or h < 20:
        return crop
    ink = gray < 170
    strip_w = min(max(w // 2, 160), w - 30, 220)
    top_h = max(16, int(h * 0.45))
    # Prefer the top band: letters sit above the figure body
    col_ink = ink[:top_h, :strip_w].mean(axis=0)
    xs = np.where(col_ink > 0.015)[0]
    if xs.size == 0:
        # Safety trim when OCR-style label is faint / anti-aliased
        cut = min(72, max(40, w // 7))
        return crop.crop((cut, 0, w, h)) if w > cut + 40 else crop

    x0 = int(xs[0])
    x1 = x0
    gap = 0
    seen_ink = False
    for x in range(x0, strip_w):
        if col_ink[x] > 0.012:
            seen_ink = True
            x1 = x
            gap = 0
        elif seen_ink:
            gap += 1
            # Letter+dot is usually 8-45px; stop at gap before axes / curve
            if gap >= 6 and (x1 - x0) >= 4:
                break
            # If blob already looks like a letter and gap is short, keep going
            if gap >= 14:
                break
    letter_w = x1 - x0 + 1
    if 4 <= letter_w <= 70 and x0 < strip_w * 0.85:
        cut = min(w - 24, x1 + 14)
    else:
        cut = min(72, max(40, w // 7))
    # Also drop a few rows if the letter sits above the figure (top-only ink)
    top_band = ink[: max(8, h // 8), cut:].mean()
    y_cut = 0
    if top_band < 0.002 and h > 40:
        # optional: no vertical trim needed when left trim cleared the letter
        y_cut = 0
    if cut < 16 or w - cut < 30:
        return crop
    return crop.crop((cut, y_cut, w, h))

def option_boxes(layout: dict, w: int, h: int, margin: int = 8) -> dict[str, CropBox]:
    y0 = layout["y0"]
    mx = layout["mid_x"]
    my = layout["mid_y"]
    y1 = layout.get("y1")
    bottom = (y1 if y1 is not None else h) - margin
    return {
        "A": CropBox(margin, y0, mx - 2, my - 2).clamp(w, h),
        "B": CropBox(mx + 2, y0, w - margin, my - 2).clamp(w, h),
        "C": CropBox(margin, my + 2, mx - 2, bottom).clamp(w, h),
        "D": CropBox(mx + 2, my + 2, w - margin, bottom).clamp(w, h),
    }


def trim_option_label(crop: Image.Image) -> Image.Image:
    """Remove leading A./B./C./D. from an option crop (left / top-left scan).

    Labels often sit well left of the figure, but some papers place them close
    to the axes (x ~ 130 inside the option cell). Scan far enough to catch both.
    """
    gray = np.asarray(crop.convert("L"))
    h, w = gray.shape
    if w < 40 or h < 20:
        return crop
    ink = gray < 170
    strip_w = min(max(w // 2, 160), w - 30, 220)
    top_h = max(16, int(h * 0.45))
    # Prefer the top band: letters sit above the figure body
    col_ink = ink[:top_h, :strip_w].mean(axis=0)
    xs = np.where(col_ink > 0.015)[0]
    if xs.size == 0:
        # Safety trim when OCR-style label is faint / anti-aliased
        cut = min(72, max(40, w // 7))
        return crop.crop((cut, 0, w, h)) if w > cut + 40 else crop

    x0 = int(xs[0])
    x1 = x0
    gap = 0
    seen_ink = False
    for x in range(x0, strip_w):
        if col_ink[x] > 0.012:
            seen_ink = True
            x1 = x
            gap = 0
        elif seen_ink:
            gap += 1
            # Letter+dot is usually 8-45px; stop at gap before axes / curve
            if gap >= 6 and (x1 - x0) >= 4:
                break
            # If blob already looks like a letter and gap is short, keep going
            if gap >= 14:

def option_boxes(layout: dict, w: int, h: int, margin: int = 8) -> dict[str, CropBox]:
    y0 = layout["y0"]
    mx = layout["mid_x"]
    my = layout["mid_y"]
    y1 = layout.get("y1")
    x0 = layout.get("x0")
    x1 = layout.get("x1")
    left = x0 if x0 is not None else margin
    right = x1 if x1 is not None else (w - margin)
    bottom = (y1 if y1 is not None else h) - (0 if y1 is not None else margin)
    # Force equal cell sizes so the 2x2 grid reconstructs cleanly
    cell_w = min(mx - 2 - left, right - (mx + 2))
    cell_h = min(my - 2 - y0, bottom - (my + 2))
    if cell_w < 40 or cell_h < 40:
        return {
            "A": CropBox(left, y0, mx - 2, my - 2).clamp(w, h),
            "B": CropBox(mx + 2, y0, right, my - 2).clamp(w, h),
            "C": CropBox(left, my + 2, mx - 2, bottom).clamp(w, h),
            "D": CropBox(mx + 2, my + 2, right, bottom).clamp(w, h),
        }
    return {
        "A": CropBox(left, y0, left + cell_w, y0 + cell_h).clamp(w, h),
        "B": CropBox(mx + 2, y0, mx + 2 + cell_w, y0 + cell_h).clamp(w, h),
        "C": CropBox(left, my + 2, left + cell_w, my + 2 + cell_h).clamp(w, h),
        "D": CropBox(mx + 2, my + 2, mx + 2 + cell_w, my + 2 + cell_h).clamp(w, h),
    }


def _ink_components(mask: np.ndarray) -> list[tuple[int, int, int, int, int]]:
    """Return (x0,y0,x1,y1,area) for each 4-connected component in a bool mask."""
    h, w = mask.shape
    visited = np.zeros_like(mask, dtype=bool)
    out: list[tuple[int, int, int, int, int]] = []
    ys, xs = np.where(mask)
    for y, x in zip(ys.tolist(), xs.tolist()):
        if visited[y, x]:
            continue
        stack = [(y, x)]
        visited[y, x] = True
        cells: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
        while stack:
            cy, cx = stack.pop()
            cells.append((cy, cx))
            for dy, dx in ((0, 1), (0, -1), (1, 0), (-1, 0)):
                ny, nx = cy + dy, cx + dx
                if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and mask[ny, nx] and not visited[ny, nx]:
                    visited[ny, nx] = True
                    stack.append((ny, nx))
        ys2 = [c[0] for c in cells]
        xs2 = [c[1] for c in cells]
        out.append((min(xs2), min(ys2), max(xs2), max(ys2), len(cells)))
    return out


def erase_option_label(crop: Image.Image) -> Image.Image:
    """White-out A./B./C./D. in place so option cell size stays unchanged."""
    rgb = np.array(crop.convert("RGB"))
    gray = np.asarray(crop.convert("L"))
    h, w = gray.shape
    if w < 40 or h < 20:
        return crop
    ink = gray < 170
    search_h = max(20, min(h // 2, 80))
    search_w = max(40, min(w // 2, 160))
    comps = _ink_components(ink[:search_h, :search_w])
    letter = None
    for x0, y0, x1, y1, area in sorted(comps, key=lambda c: (c[0], c[1])):
        bw, bh = x1 - x0 + 1, y1 - y0 + 1
        if not (5 <= bw <= 42 and 8 <= bh <= 40 and 20 <= area <= 550):
            continue
        # Must sit near the top-left; skip axis labels like p sitting mid-cell
        if y0 > search_h * 0.55 or x0 > search_w * 0.55:
            continue
        # Prefer a blob that has a gap before the next ink (letter then graph)
        right_probe = ink[max(0, y0 - 2) : min(h, y1 + 8), x1 + 1 : min(w, x1 + 80)]
        if right_probe.size and right_probe.any():
            cols = np.where(right_probe.any(axis=0))[0]
            gap = int(cols[0]) if cols.size else 80
            if gap < 4:
                continue
        letter = (x0, y0, x1, y1)
        break
    if letter is None:
        return crop
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = letter
    # Include a nearby period to the right of the letter
    period = ink[y0:y1 + 4, x1 + 1 : min(w, x1 + 18)]
    if period.any():
        px = np.where(period.any(axis=0))[0]
        x1 = x1 + 1 + int(px[-1])
    pad = 4
    rgb[
        max(0, y0 - pad) : min(h, y1 + pad + 1),
        max(0, x0 - pad) : min(w, x1 + pad + 1),
    ] = 255
    return Image.fromarray(rgb)


def trim_option_label(crop: Image.Image) -> Image.Image:
    """Remove leading A./B./C./D. by left-crop (vertical stacks / tight boxes)."""
    erased = erase_option_label(crop)
    gray = np.asarray(erased.convert("L"))
    h, w = gray.shape
    if w < 40 or h < 20:
        return erased
    ink = gray < 170
    # After erase, snug to content on the left only when there is a wide empty gutter
    col = ink.mean(axis=0)
    xs = np.where(col > 0.004)[0]
    if xs.size == 0:
        return erased
    cut = max(0, int(xs[0]) - 4)
    if cut < 12 or w - cut < 30:
        return erased
    return erased.crop((cut, 0, w, h))


def pad_to_size(crop: Image.Image, width: int, height: int) -> Image.Image:
    """Top-left paste onto a white canvas of fixed size."""
    if crop.size == (width, height):
        return crop
    canvas = Image.new("RGB", (width, height), (255, 255, 255))
    canvas.paste(crop.convert("RGB"), (0, 0))
    return canvas


def save_crop(
    image: Image.Image,
    box: CropBox,
    dest: Path,
    *,
    trim_option_letter: bool = False,
    erase_option_letter: bool = False,
) -> tuple[str, int, int]:
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    crop = image.crop(box.as_tuple())
    if erase_option_letter:
        crop = erase_option_label(crop)
    elif trim_option_letter:
        crop = trim_option_label(crop)
    crop.save(dest)
    data = dest.read_bytes()
    return sha256_bytes(data), crop.width, crop.height

"""Export reconstructed PDF pages + check 2012:16 stem top."""
from pathlib import Path
import fitz
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

out = Path('.lavish/samples/recon')
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Map structured questions to year PDF page order (by question number)
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('paper2db.sqlite')
rows = conn.execute("""
  SELECT q.paper_id, q.number, q.id
  FROM question q
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM asset_role ar WHERE ar.question_id=q.id AND ar.role='option_figure'
  )
  ORDER BY q.paper_id, q.number
""").fetchall()

# Group by paper
from collections import defaultdict
by_paper = defaultdict(list)
for paper, num, qid in rows:
    by_paper[paper].append((num, qid))

for paper, items in by_paper.items():
    pdf = Path(f'reconstructed/{paper}/combined.pdf')
    if not pdf.is_file():
        print('missing', pdf)
        continue
    doc = fitz.open(pdf)
    # pages are in same order as structured questions for that year
    for i, (num, qid) in enumerate(items):
        if i >= doc.page_count:
            print('no page', qid)
            continue
        page = doc[i]
